scope: MNA netlist and worker refresh before OPT-006

observations.netlistRefresh: SimulationEngine.refreshMnaElements calls buildMNACircuit with all nodes and wires for every live model refresh
observations.connectivityWork: Every refresh re-registers pins, merges direct wires, evaluates breadboard internal links, and evaluates breadboard proximity links
observations.workerUpdate: SimulationWorker.UPDATE_ELEMENTS replaces the complete element array and calls MNASolver.setElements
observations.mutableElementGranularity: No element-level value patch message exists
observations.topologyLifecycle: A changed MNA node count stops and recreates the worker

limitation: Browser compile timings, worker lifecycle counts, and breadboard/direct-wire runtime traces were unavailable; validate cache reuse, patch counts, and connectivity equivalence through OPT-FB-006.
